boolean_colour_chamber.name: Boolean Colour Chamber
boolean_colour_chamber.description: Three architectural CSG recipes with a level passage and independent pearl, amber, chrome and chalk finishes. Pointer-selectable materials; optional slow surface drift; geometry remains static.

parameters.mode: path, lens or shell; configure before entry

interactions: Enter through a carved opening and walk to the other side.
Point at PEARL, AMBER, CHROME or CHALK on the entrance plinth.
Use DRIFT to start or hold the surface phase.
boolean_colour_chamber.qfep_connection: A composed boundary can remain fixed while another rule changes its appearance. Which opening admits a body, a view or concealment depends on dimensions and arrangement.
boolean_colour_chamber.validation: Native desktop study and bounded collision/pointer checks; headset and museum-loader verification remain pending.
